after.basic_english: After O-O, Black's king on g8 adds support to Black's pawn on h7, which is under attack from White's bishop on d3. Nxc5 clears e4; later Bxh7+ passes through that square in this line. In the O-O line, Black's king on g8 keeps supporting Black's pawn on h7 after O-O ends the support from Black's rook on h8. When Bxh7+ captures that pawn, Kxh7 recaptures its capturer with the supporting king. After O-O, Black's rook on f8 does not support Black's pawn on h7; after Rb8, Black's rook on h8 supports Black's pawn on h7. In the O-O line: With Bxh7+, the white bishop originally on d3 captures the black pawn originally on h7; with Kxh7, the black king originally on e8 recaptures that piece. Bxh7+ clears d3; Qd3+ later occupies that square in this line. The recorded continuation is Qd3+ Kg8. O-O castles, bringing the rook from h8 to f8. In the provided O-O line: Bxh7+ gives check to the Black king on g8 with White's bishop on h7. Kxh7 moves the king to h7 and captures the checking bishop on h7. Qd3+ gives check to the Black king on h7 with White's queen on d3. Kg8 moves the king to g8. In the O-O line, both sides exchange one bishop; White gives up two knights for two pawns and one bishop.
